title: Pseudocode and Trace Tables
welcome_lead: Express algorithms cleanly in pseudocode and trace variables line by line.
meta_desc: IBDP CS adventure on pseudocode style and trace table debugging.
final_note: Trace tables catch logic bugs before they ruin your day!

concepts.def: Table tracking variable values per line.
Repeats statements while a condition holds.
Branch executed based on a boolean.
Manually step through code on paper.

walkthroughs.body_html:
x = 5; LOOP WHILE x > 0; OUTPUT x; x = x - 1; END LOOP.

Compact and unambiguous, free from language quirks.

Trace x=5: iterations output 5,4,3,2,1.

Columns: iteration, x, condition, output.

If condition was x ≥ 0 instead, output would include 0.

Trace tables reveal these mistakes quickly.
